name: Degree-2 polynomials with the edge values and the average in [m, M] but not the interior point (Remark 2.3 of the source)
source: Zhang and Shu, J. Comput. Phys. 229 (2010), (2.1)-(2.6), Theorem 2.2; the Lax-Friedrichs flux h(u, v) = (f(u) + f(v) - a (v - u))/2 for f(u) = u, a = max|f'| = 1

reconstruction.update: ubar - lam*((u0r + up1l)/2 - (up1l - u0r)/2 - ((um1r + u0l)/2 - (u0l - um1r)/2))

claims.why: p_0 with p(-1/2) = M, p(1/2) = m and average M is admitted (its interior value exceeds M); with um1r = M the update is M + lam (M - m) > M for lam > 0
